regions.description: Dread, inexorable gravitational pull, industrial catastrophe (a failed mining rig).

regions.name: The Polar Shift
regions.description: Driving/urgent, magnetic push-pull traversal — bouncing between charged surfaces.

regions.name: Paradox Engine (region)
regions.description: Frantic, glitchy-fast, portal-warp texture — a machine hunts you through a maze.

regions.name: Chrono-Space Rift
regions.description: Looping/temporal, bittersweet — anything that exits one side reappears on the other.

regions.name: The Fracture
regions.description: The tutorial/opening region, later tied to the game's own loop-reset ending — bittersweet.

regions.name: Timeline Crossroads (region)
regions.description: Past/present overlap, ghostly duality, bureaucratic control — trains and prisoners.

regions.name: Graviton Core
regions.description: Oppressive, mechanical — gravity-flipping levers, the Sovereign's elite guard.

regions.name: Static Field
regions.description: Electromagnetic arcs, glitchy/corrupting — touching the floor zaps you airborne.

regions.name: Crag of the Colossus
regions.description: Rocky, primal, collapsing — a ruthless mining operation.

regions.name: The Vault / Hollow Core / The Rift
regions.description: Heavy, isolating, sacred — the late-game vault cluster before the final approach.

regions.name: Hub / Living Areas

bosses.name: Crag Warden
bosses.description: Brutal, merciless, rock-heavy mining-operation menace, super-armored charge attacks.

bosses.name: The Mirror King
bosses.description: Narcissistic, recursive, uncanny self-duplication, cold clinical superiority.

bosses.name: Gravity Collapse Core
bosses.description: Industrial catastrophe, inexorable pull, mechanical dread, flying robot.

bosses.name: Temporal Warden
bosses.description: Melancholy, weary, powerful-but-guilty — a tragic reluctant mentor-fight, not purely hostile.

bosses.name: Fractured Sovereign's Guard
bosses.description: Hollow duty, martial, tragic loyal soldier, shield-clang.

bosses.name: Electromagnetic Golem
bosses.description: Industrial magnetism, remote-controlled menace, push-pull tension.

bosses.name: Quantum Pursuer
bosses.description: Haunting, exploitative soul-harvest horror, relentless pursuit.

bosses.name: Warden & Hollow (duo)
bosses.description: Bureaucratic-eternal, procedural, two-voice call-and-response, gatekeeper tedium turned lethal.

bosses.name: The Conduit
bosses.description: High-voltage, glitchy corruption, clinical engineer menace.

bosses.name: The Assembler
bosses.description: Frantic, glitchy-fast, portal-warp texture, mechanical precision.

bosses.name: Timeline Crossroads' scientist-boss
bosses.description: Bureaucratic control, trains/industrial transit, morally compromised authority, cold calculation. (Supersedes the old "Stationmaster" name.)

bosses.name: The Sovereign (final boss)
bosses.description: Mirror-of-the-player, inevitable, the most dramatic/final theme in the game — fighting your own future self.

bosses.name: Void Expanse miniboss (new, unnamed)
bosses.description: A scientist's child merged with darkness — steals what's held dear, teleports through the void. No live track yet — this fight has no code hook in game/boss.js/area.js.

bosses.name: The Child (Antechamber fight)
bosses.description: Intimate, tragic, scrappy improvised weapons (tasers/flamethrowers/bombs/guns), escalating desperation across 3 phases. No live track yet — this fight has no code hook.

enemy_sfx.name: Void Tether — Cast (going out)
enemy_sfx.description: Now LIVE (assets/audio/sfx/voidTetherCast.ogg) — plays the instant the tether latches onto a target or grapples a wall. Was previously silent (reused SFX.dash()).

enemy_sfx.name: Void Tether — Hit (arrival, size-scaled)
enemy_sfx.description: Now LIVE (assets/audio/sfx/voidTetherHit.ogg) — plays SFX.voidTetherHit(sizeFactor) on arrival; pitch center shifts by target size (bigger = lower/heavier). Was previously completely silent on arrival.

enemy_sfx.description: Wired 2026-08-02 to Crystal Sentinel's shield break and Electromagnetic Golem's Magnetize charge-up. Fractured Knight's Shield Slip and Sovereign's Guard's shield break still silent.
